description:
Bridge 0.3.2 restores Gboard dictation after the Wispr Flow 2.8.8 update. It also supports Wispr Flow 2.8.5 and 2.8.7. Update the LSPosed bridge and restart Wispr Flow. If you already have the Gboard patch from v4.3.0-wispr.1, you can keep using it.

For a new setup, use Android 14 or later and patch Gboard 18.5.4.993608717-release-arm64-v8a with Wispr Flow selected in Morphe. Enable the bridge in LSPosed with Wispr Flow as its scope.
